text: IREN Limited's 2025 proxy statement lists no beneficial owner of more than 5% of its ordinary shares as of 31 August 2025.
short: IREN Limited has no shareholder above 5%.

source.name: IREN Limited: Definitive Proxy Statement (Schedule 14A) for the 2025 Annual Meeting, 'Security Ownership of Certain Beneficial Owners and Management' (SEC EDGAR)
source.note: The table lists every person or group known to own more than 5% of the ordinary or B Class shares; the only row under 'Principal Shareholders' is 'None'.

additionalSources.name: MarketScreener – 'IREN Limited: Shareholders, Shareholding Structure'
additionalSources.note: Secondary source for the state element: governments are 0.48% of the shareholder base, under the 5% threshold.
